# extension authoring foundation

_status: experimental · owner: core · id: `extensions.authoring`_

## the one command

```
hosaka extensions create my-extension
```

## why you care

Start an independent package without modifying core or exposing provider secrets.

## what it does

Scaffold, validate and discover independent extension.yaml packages and declarative views; manage private registration and owner lifecycle metadata. Authoring never executes package code; execution requires separate approval.

## commands

- `/extensions init`
- `/extensions list`
- `/extensions create <id>`
- `/extensions validate <id-or-path>`
- `/extensions link <path>`
- `/extensions info <id>`
- `/extensions enable <id>`
- `/extensions disable <id>`
- `/extensions remove <id>`
- `/extensions doctor`

## entrypoints

- script: `hosaka/extensions/__main__.py`

## what success looks like / what failure looks like

if it works, it's quiet. if it doesn't, expect one of:

- invalid manifests or duplicate IDs are diagnosed without hiding unrelated valid packages
- corrupt registration fails explicitly; bootstrap never resets owner decisions
- enablement alone never grants code approval or data access

dig deeper:
- `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8421/api/v1/events?feature_id=extensions.authoring&limit=20 | jq`
- `/doctor`
